newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares steady on the Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares steady on the Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Bank shares held steady on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday as Audi shares traded at $16.125 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares at $12.
Solidere A shares fell slightly to $10.625 from Friday's $10.75 while B shares rose to $11.125 from $11.

Turnover in BLC was 10,830 shares compared to 10,000 shares traded on Friday. Also traded were 57,761 Audi shares from Friday's 21,570. Monday's turnover included 21,630 Audi shares traded in blocks outside the BSE.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic UNI.BY and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 105,457 shares compared with 89,015 shares on Friday and value was $1,342,071 against $998,123.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.04 percent to 918.66 and the LISPI stock index was unchanged at 81.58.
